ModMetaData.name: Walk the World
ModMetaData.author: addvans
ModMetaData.description:
Explore every inch of the planet! Walk your drafted pawns all the way to the corner of the map in order to move them to neighbor map. Attack hostile settlements, visit and trade with friendly settlements - become a fully independent explorer!
Technical note: map will reset after you leaving it, therefore resetting it's terrain and respawning animals, if any there were.
